question: In which type of forests are Mahogany, Rosewood and Cinchona trees found in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical Evergreen forests**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahogany, Rosewood, and Cinchona trees** are typically found in **Tropical Evergreen forests** in India.
 
• Tropical Evergreen forests are characterized by **high rainfall, usually above 200 cm annually, and a warm climate.**
 
• These forests are dense, multi-layered, and host a diverse range of flora and fauna.
 
• They are primarily found in regions such as the **Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and parts of northeastern India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tropical Evergreen forests are also known as **rainforests** due to their lush, green appearance throughout the year.
 
• The continuous canopy in these forests allows little sunlight to reach the ground, resulting in a sparse undergrowth.
 
• These forests play a crucial role in maintaining ecological balance and are vital for biodiversity conservation.
 
• Other notable trees found in **Tropical Evergreen forests include ebony, rubber, and bamboo**.
